name: Toumei Ningen! Jikan Teishi! Saimin Jutsu!
original_name: 透明人間!時間停止!催眠術!
source:
One day, a man was bestowed incredible powers ...
He's become invisible, and sneaks into a woman's home! Hiding and watching her in the bedroom, toilet and bath! He even spies on her during her work!

He's a time-stopper, and can freeze and lick any woman's holes! They can't move their body even a step! Around town and on trains he takes their clothes, leaving them in a panic!

He's a hypnotist, and can make anyone believe anything! That which is strange can never be confirmed!

This man is nearly a god... what will be his last vision...!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE069533.html]DLsite english[/url]]
